lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs posterior to the gills, transitioning to a sparser grid of larger spots on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like pattern across the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal ridges running horizontally along the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting sharp light-to-shadow vertical gradients.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a dense distribution of smaller high-luminance blobs that lack the structured vertical alignment seen on the main flank.
